gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-vithkuqi: Warnes draws tapered ink strokes with no thick or thin at all. Noto Sans Vithkuqi, by contrast, keeps open throats and a small step from capitals to lowercase, so it simply gets on with the reading.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-wancho: Warnes stretches out wide, its strokes tapering off before they touch. Noto Sans Wancho is the heavy one, with a hulking lowercase and a wide gap in the e, so it holds the text down while the heading performs.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-warang-citi: Warnes gives its tails and terminals the same heft as its stems, with generous tracking between letters. And Noto Sans Warang Citi lets words settle into solid blocks, with wide channels leading into every counter.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-yi: Expressive curves that never thin out lead the way here, spaced wide and loose in Warnes. Noto Sans Yi follows with a deep-bodied, open-ended lowercase, which makes the pair sturdy.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-zanabazar-squ: Wide, spacious and bold, Warnes looks like it was drawn with a fixed pen that never changes pressure. Noto Sans Zanabazar Square rises tall in the lowercase with wide gaps, so a full page stays crisp and friendly.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-traditional-nushu: Noto Traditional Nushu moves like a broad-nibbed pen, with bowls that fill the line and curves that never curl shut. Warnes is the showy one, tracing each letter in one constant line.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-numans: Warnes draws pencil-like lines that never thicken or thin, stretched out with plenty of space between letters. Numans swells its lowercase tight like coiled rope, hanging the ends of the s far from the spine, and reads loosely.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-onest: Onest reads approachable and modern, with short ascenders sitting above big bowls and a gentle, steady line. And Warnes gives it a bold, stretched-out heading that the sans can happily sit beneath.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-open-sans: Open Sans reads smoothly, with bulky lowercase proportions and no clogged curves anywhere in the paragraph. Warnes is the bold, soft-humming display voice, while Open Sans does the plain work.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-orienta: Thread-thin outlines, stitched plain and stretched wide, give Warnes a look all its own, with no contrast anywhere. Orienta's breathing counters and small height gap between cases handle the text.
